sloka: सीता यस्य स्नुषा च आसीत् शरण्यो धर्मवत्सलः ।तस्य पुत्रः शरण्यस्य सुग्रीवम् शरणम् गतः ॥४-४-१९॥
transliteration: sītā yasya snuṣā ca āsīt śaraṇyo dharmavatsalaḥ ।tasya putraḥ śaraṇyasya sugrīvam śaraṇam gataḥ ॥4-4-19॥

translations.english: 'One whose father was once a protector of dharma, a refuge to all now seeks Sugriva's shelter.
